title: Nonlinear light absorption in Ti3C2Tx MXene: a theoretical study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23934-23942
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01751C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hayk Minassian, Armen Melikyan, Manuel Rodrigues Gonçalves, Petros Petrosyan
We use published results of calculations of the band structure of titanium carbide MXene and apply the density matrix theory to calculate the nonlinear absorption coefficient for a two-band model, in the resonance approximation.
